name: System Design
description: Comprehensive study guide covering Low-Level Design (LLD) and High-Level Design (HLD).

name: Low-Level Design (LLD) / Object-Oriented Design
description: Focuses on classes, objects, interfaces, and design patterns.

name: High-Level Design (HLD) / System Architecture
description: Focuses on system architecture, databases, scaling, and network protocols.

name: Design Principles (SOLID)
description: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion.

name: Design Patterns (Gang of Four)
description: Creational, Structural, and Behavioral patterns in enterprise systems.

name: Architectural Patterns
description: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, and Serverless architectures.

name: Caching Systems
description: Redis, Memcached, distributed caching strategies, eviction policies, and invalidation.

name: Data Management & Storage
description: RDBMS vs NoSQL, sharding, replication, partitioning, and ACID transactions.

name: Asynchronous Communication
description: Message brokers, Kafka, RabbitMQ, pub/sub models, and event streaming.

name: Security & Identity
description: Authentication, authorization, OAuth2, JWT, encryption, and secure APIs.

name: Monitoring & Observability
description: Metrics, tracing, logging, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and APM.
